newsitem.title: UK: Austin Reed Christmas sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austin Reed Christmas sales up 10 pct.

text.p: Up-market clothing retailer Austin Reed Group Plc said on Tuesday its sales were 10 percent ahead for the season up to Christmas, with improved margins across the business, particularly in womenswear.

Since Christmas, the winter sales period had performed according to plan with the achievement of better margins, and initial customer reaction to the new season's lines had also been encouraging, the company said in a statement.
It said its wholesale business in mainland Europe had continued to trade at depressed levels due to lack of customer confidence and spending in the key markets, however.
Chester Barrie hand-tailored clothing and Stephens Brothers shirts had performed according to expectations, with the former particularly strong in the U.S., the statement said.

Chairman Colin Evans commented, "The new management team which we put in place six months ago is having a positive impact on the business and the prospects for a steady improvement in our results are good."
